checks.why: an error and a genuine no-match look identical once stderr is discarded, and this repo has already shipped three defects that hid in exactly that gap
command: plugins/productizer/skills/spec/scripts/build-view.sh::2>/dev/null || :::the view builder runs against a repo that may have no history, no tags and no remote; every one of these lines already turns a failure into no data with || : , and git writes a fatal to stderr for the empty case, which is expected and not an error

plugins/productizer/skills/spec/scripts/build-view.sh::--git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1::an existence probe for a git work tree, the same shape as command -v; the answer is the exit status and the only thing on stderr is git saying this is not a repository

plugins/productizer/skills/spec/scripts/run-checks.sh::$pid" 2>/dev/null::kill and wait address a pid this script started and owns; the only stderr is ESRCH from a child that already exited, which is the ordinary case this loop is written around

plugins/productizer/skills/spec/scripts/run-checks.sh::git merge-base "$BASE" HEAD 2>/dev/null::the very next line refuses the whole run and names the base that could not be resolved, so the failure is reported rather than lost - the cost is that git own wording goes with it
